issues.description: generate-stories requires an existing story manifest before it can generate the manifest, so a fresh checkout cannot bootstrap data.
Documented demo/extraction commands are not runnable from the checked-out repo because data/stories is empty.
Integration test unconditionally runs the full gated-model pipeline without preflight skips for missing HF auth or story data.
Generated output artifacts are present and claim 80 stories were used, but the corresponding input dataset is absent.
all_token_activations materializes every token, layer, and hidden dimension in memory, creating avoidable OOM risk on real runs.
Very short tokenized inputs can produce L == s and divide by zero during mean activation weighting.
PCA on zero-variance or degenerate inputs divides by var.sum() and can return NaN components.
Story loading does not validate manifest consistency, file existence, or non-empty content before extraction.
External story-generation HTTP calls have no timeout, retry, or response-status handling and can hang indefinitely.
Lower-bound-only ML dependencies with no lock file make the pipeline brittle and hard to reproduce.
The only story dataset coverage is skipped when data is missing, so default tests allow the broken empty-data checkout.
Ignored generated/build directories are still present in the repo workspace, including outputs and emovec.egg-info.
